widgets.text: Made by the Royal Fiesta contributors
Move: KeyW/KeyZ KeyA/KeyQ KeyS KeyD or arrows or left stick
Camera: mouse (click the game to capture, Esc releases) or right stick
WASD/ZQSD move - mouse or right stick: camera - 1-4 emote - Enter or green pad: play - Esc menu
Up/Down choose - Enter select - Esc back
Left/Right choose - Enter vote - Esc pause
